Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: 30d action grid + environment readiness checklist

Hi Marta — thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have a single reference for the pilot kickoff. Please confirm or flag any items I missed.

Key pain points you called out
- Latency spikes on batch inference (95th percentile > 1.2s) that impact live support workflows
- High per-token cost for high-volume reranking flows
- Tight data governance: PII must never be logged outside customer-managed storage; SOC2 evidence required for audit

Pilot goals (30d scope)
1) Validate 95th pctl latency under 800ms for the reranker and keep avg cost/token below $0.0009 on the target load
2) Run prompt/eval suite (sample size ~2k queries) to measure top-k precision and hallucination rate baseline
3) Prove secure ingestion path with read-only S3 and customer KMS for keys

Proposed pilot scope & success metrics
- Model: open-archiver-7B (quantized) + fallback to redwood-latency-6B for cold starts
- Workload: reranking + short generation; expected token rate ~120k/day
- Acceptance gates: 95th pctl latency <= 800ms, precision@5 >= 0.72 on eval set, no plaintext PII in logs

Owners (tentative)
- Customer PM: Marta Ruiz (ClearMind) — business acceptance
- Customer Eng: Sales Ops team (ops@clearmind.ai) — infra & data access
- Redwood: Priyom Das — engagement lead; Ben Carter — runtime ops; Karthik Iyer — solutions engineer

Immediate action items (next 7 days)
- Customer: share a redacted sample of the eval prompts (2k rows) + estimated daily token counts (Marta) — due Wed 3/31
- Customer: grant read-only S3 path and add redwood-poc@clearmind-iam role with listed permissions (Sales Ops) — due Thu 4/1
- Redwood: produce environment readiness checklist and SOW draft v1 (attached) — Priyom / Ben — due Fri 4/2
- Redwood: run quick smoke test using a 200-sample prompt set to validate networking and auth — Ben — due Mon 4/5

Attachments: draft SOW (clearmind-poc-scope-v1.pdf), environment checklist (environment-access-checklist.xlsx), data flow diagram (data-flow-diagram.png).

If that all looks right I’ll schedule the kickoff (30–45 minute ops + security sync) for next Tuesday. Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Priyom Das

Thanks, Priyom — this is very helpful. A few clarifications from our side: we can share a redacted prompt set but one of the dimensions we care about is conditional outputs when the input includes customer IDs (hashed). We will also need an explicit non-logging confirmation in the SOW for any token cache/kv-store behavior.

Quick answers:
- Eval sample: we can provide ~2.2k rows, with a mix of reranker + gen prompts. We'll deliver a CSV by Wed EOD (Marta).
- Data: our S3 bucket lives in us-east-1; size of sample data ~120MB. We will create a read-only role and send the ARN to redwood-poc@clearmind-iam by Thu.
- Compliance: we need SOC2 evidence for the dedicated pilot (if we move beyond hosted). Can you add a short appendix listing what evidence you can provide (audit logs, retention settings, KMS integration notes)?

Adding a short technical checklist and preliminary timeline from the runtime side. I’ll own the smoke runs and the perf reports.

Runtime checklist (Redwood ops)
- Confirm S3 read-only access + test object listing (we will not copy data off-site)
- Provide the ARN for the role we should assume; we will require sts:AssumeRole with explicit external-id if you want it
- Agree on KMS pattern: customer-managed KMS key for all at-rest artifacts — we will not persist any unencrypted intermediate cache to customer buckets
- Network: allow outbound to redwood-control.redwoodinference.com and open egress for model fetch on 443 from our runtime subnets
- Token retention: default is 0 days for raw prompts in logs for hosted pilots; we can set to 0 retention for this pilot and capture only evaluation hashes

Pilot timeline (tentative)
- 3/31: customer provides eval CSV + S3 role
- 4/1: Redwood validates access and runs initial connectivity check
- 4/2–4/4: smoke perf runs and prompt/eval pass (200 -> 2k samples)
- 4/5: internal review of metrics; 4/6: joint readout with ClearMind

Success metric instrumentation
- We’ll supply a small dashboard (link in HubSpot record) measuring token counts, 95th/median latency, cost/token, and precision@k for the eval set. Ben will drop the first perf snapshot by EOD 4/5.

Attachment: environment-access-checklist.xlsx (permissions matrix + example IAM policy).

—
